title: se-implementation-scratchpad-brightwater-credit
content:
Quick scratchpad for Brightwater Credit onboarding - implementation notes and immediate TODOs.

Context: Brightwater Credit (regional credit union) wants Private deployment in AWS GovCloud-equivalent region (they flagged data residency + Fed-regulated controls). Primary use case: chat assistant for customer support + document summarization (statements, loan docs). SLO: p95 response latency < 350ms for short chat utterances (<=128 tokens), throughput ~600 rps peak for chat (estimate).

Decisions so far:
- Recommend Private deployment (customer-managed VPC) with Redwood Private control plane. They insisted on HSM/KMS integration.
- Model family: start with small-medium open model (e.g., Mistral-base-like 7B quantized) for pilot; plan dedicated pool for higher throughput after validation.
- KV/prefix caching enabled for statement summarization to lower cost on repeated docs.

Immediate technical action items (owner initials):
- [JP] Draft network diagram for VPC peering and private endpoints (include Ops + Security requirements) - due 2026-03-05.
- [RG] Confirm KMS/HSM vendor and integration details (do they require dedicated HSM or can we use AWS KMS with external key material?) - ask security team to join call.
- [SD] Load profile validation: get sample request traces from Brightwater support traffic (hourly distribution) - jira SE-4821 assigned.
- [LO] Prepare onboarding checklist (IAM roles, subnets, SG rules, NAT vs. egress restrictions).

Config notes / checks:
- Subnets: need at least 3 AZ subnets for high-availability. Confirm AZs available in customer region (GovCloud-ish).
- Egress: customer requires egress allowlist only to Redwood control plane IPs + KMS endpoints. Need static IP ranges for control plane (ask infra for export).
- KMS: plan to use AWS KMS with external key material unless customer insists on HSM. Need integration test with CMKs created in their account.
- Logging: they require audit logs forwarded to their SIEM (Splunk). Config: CloudWatch -> Kinesis -> Splunk HTTP Event Collector.
- Data retention: 30 days of raw logs, 7 years of redacted audit trail (compliance asks).

Model/runtime tuning notes:
- Quantization: 4-bit quant recommended for cost; validate quality on loan doc summarization test-suite.
- Batching: target batching window 15ms with smart routing for latency-sensitive chat paths. For summarization background jobs can use larger batches to reduce cost.
- KV-cache: configure per-customer prefix caching for repeated doc chunks. Cache invalidation policy: 24h default, configurable by customer.

Open questions / risk items:
- Does Brightwater accept token-level logs (even if encrypted) for root-cause analysis? They were hesitant. If no, we need a plan for reduced telemetry + synthetic tests to monitor model health.
- Network: can they provide a managed NAT gateway for egress? If not, we may need to propose VPC endpoints for KMS and S3 only.
- Throughput: our estimate 600 rps peak might be low. Action: request 30-day sample traffic or at least peak-day stats.

Meeting notes (2026-02-20 call w/ Brightwater):
- Security lead (Carlos M.) emphasized need for signed SLA and on-premise option discussion if GovCloud doesn't meet regs.
- Platform lead asked about rollout phases: pilot -> dedicated pool commit -> full private with HSM. They liked canary rollback idea.
- Ops asked about autoscaling latency impact; we should show demo of warm pool + steady KV caching.

Short-term checklist (this week):
- Send network diagram draft to customer (JP).
- Get KMS/HSM vendor confirmation + security contact for integration (RG).
- Upload initial summary eval results (loan-doc summarization) using quantized model to linked PR and Confluence (SD/LO).
- Book 1-hour design review with infra and security next Tue (2026-03-02).

Notes-to-self:
- Keep messages short in demos; show tail-latency numbers.
- Bring up rollback/fallback options (hosted->dedicated->private compatibility).
- Save sample prompts + scoring rubric into Confluence under Brightwater evals.

Reference commands / snippets (for quick reuse):
- Check control plane reachability: curl -I https://control.redwood.ai/healthz --resolve control.redwood.ai:443:<STATIC_IP>
- KMS test: aws kms encrypt --key-id arn:aws:kms:... --plaintext "test" --profile brightwater-test

Linked artifacts (internal): CONFLUENCE:Brightwater-Credit-Integration (draft architecture), JIRA:SE-4821 (traffic sample + onboarding tasks), PR: github.com/redwood-inference/se-scripts/pull/89 (kv-cache helper scripts).

End scratchpad — will clean and move into formal onboarding doc once network + KMS answers confirmed.

Quick TODO summary: [JP] diagram, [RG] KMS vendor, [SD] traffic samples, [LO] onboarding checklist.
